newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Taiwan futures volume hits new record.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Taiwan futures volume hits new record.

text.p: SIMEX MSCI Taiwan index futures saw a record turnover of over 2,000 lots on Friday, with the March and April contracts ending sharply lower following a huge sell-off in Taipei stocks.
The March contract ended at 342.5 against its opening 359.5 on volume of 1,251 lots. April was at 343.5 against 356.1 on 973 lots.

Taiwan's weighted share index plunged 262.60 points to end at 8,230.07 as an export ban on fresh and frozen pork and the government's latest attempt to cool down the overheated market triggered aggressive sales, dealers said.
They said a letter by Taiwan's Securities and Exchange Commission chief Lu Tung-ying to securities brokerages urging them to protect investors' rights after recent market rallies dampened sentiment.

"Negative stock market reports in the Taiwan press, stating foreign and domestic institutions were net sellers on Thursday, made domestic investors nervous and heavy selling occurred across the board," Refco (Singapore) Pte Ltd said in a daily commentary.
